title: Automated Root-Cause Subclassification and No-Code Fix Generation for Invalid Bug Reports
abstract: arXiv:2605.17561v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Issues faced when using software are reported in the form of bug reports. However, many bug reports are invalid, meaning they do not require code changes, and are resolved with a no-code fix. Manually determining the root cause of the invalid bug reports and providing actionable resolutions by the customer support causes a serious waste of resources. Our goal is to introduce a standardized taxonomy for root-cause oriented invalid bug report subclassification, and perform experiments to test the accuracy of various approaches on invalid subclassification and no-code fix generation. We study how different configurations perform on a gold-standard benchmark we have created. Using a manually curated benchmark for higher quality analysis, we experimented with vanilla LLMs, Retrieval Augmented Generation, and agentic web search to identify invalid subclasses and generate no-code fixes. translated_title: 无效错误报告的自动根因细分与无代码修复方案生成
translated_abstract: 使用软件时遇到的问题通常以错误报告（bug report）的形式提交。然而，许多错误报告是无效的，即它们不需要修改代码，而是通过无代码修复来解决。由客户支持人员人工判定无效错误报告的根因并提供可操作的解决方案会造成严重的资源浪费。我们的目标是引入一个标准化的分类体系，对无效错误报告进行面向根因的细分，并通过实验测试多种方法在无效报告细分和无代码修复方案生成上的准确性。我们研究了不同配置在我们构建的黄金标准基准上的表现。为进行更高质量的分析，我们使用人工整理的基准数据，尝试了原始大语言模型（LLMs）、检索增强生成（RAG）以及基于智能体的网络搜索来识别无效报告的子类别并生成无代码修复方案。我们根据人工标注的结果对各方法的表现进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个面向根因的无效错误报告标准化分类体系，并利用大语言模型、检索增强生成和智能体网络搜索自动实现无效错误报告的根因细分与无代码修复方案生成，从而减少客户支持的人工资源浪费。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a standardized root-cause taxonomy for invalid bug reports and leverages vanilla LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic web search to automatically subclassify invalid reports and generate no-code fixes, reducing manual customer support overhead.
